topic: Never shared your OTP? You can still lose money — 3 money myths: (1) you enter a PIN to receive money (NPCI: never; a PIN on a 'Paying' screen sends money out); (2) scammed money is gone, so don't report (1930 / cybercrime.gov.in can get it blocked in the next accounts; ₹11,158 crore+ saved till 30 Jun 2026, MHA; ₹1.04 lakh returned in Delhi, ANI 27 Nov 2026); (3) the bank never pays back (RBI circular 6 Jul 2017: not your fault + reported within 3 working days = zero liability; RBI Directions from 1 Jan 2027: 5 calendar days, and up to ₹25,000 on a small loss even if tricked); one-minute check: your registered mobile number in your bank app
